sqlReports.label: Store
sqlReports.tooltip: Reports are grouped by store — pick one to see and edit its reports

sqlReports.label: New report
sqlReports.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-plus "><path d="M12 5l0 14"></path><path d="M5 12l14 0"></path></svg>
sqlReports.tooltip: Create a new report in this store (choose a main db, or None, in the editor)

sqlReports.label: Search reports…
sqlReports.tooltip: Show only the reports whose name or description contains the text

sqlReports.label: Edit (pencil)
sqlReports.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-pencil "><path d="M4 20h4l10.5 -10.5a2.828 2.828 0 1 0 -4 -4l-10.5 10.5v4"></path><path d="M13.5 6.5l4 4"></path></svg>

sqlReports.label: Table
sqlReports.tooltip: Run and show the result in the SQL Table panel

sqlReports.label: Coloring
sqlReports.tooltip: Run the coloring query, then choose how to apply it

sqlReports.label: Set color
sqlReports.tooltip: Run your current Set Color rules + the result appended as one extra Multi rule (Set Color panel untouched)

sqlReports.label: White
sqlReports.tooltip: Everything white + the returned rows their own colors (Set Color panel untouched)

sqlReports.label: Hidden
sqlReports.tooltip: Isolate the result: hits keep their colors, everything else fades to opacity 0 (Reset model recovers)

sqlReports.label: Transparent
sqlReports.tooltip: White base at 10% opacity + the returned rows their own colors — the model stays faintly visible

sqlReports.label: Selection
sqlReports.tooltip: Select every returned fullname in the viewer

sqlReportsEditor.label: Name
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: The report name shown in the list

sqlReportsEditor.label: Description
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Shown above the report’s filters — **bold** and new lines work

sqlReportsEditor.label: Main db
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: The database opened directly. Pick None to run purely off ATTACH'd files (an in-memory scratch db is used).

sqlReportsEditor.label: Types: COLORING / TABLE / DETAIL
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Enable the COLORING output

sqlReportsEditor.label: Info (i)
sqlReportsEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-info-circle "><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 18 0a9 9 0 0 0 -18 0"></path><path d="M12 9h.01"></path><path d="M11 12h1v4h1"></path></svg>
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: How report SQL runs

sqlReportsEditor.label: As Table
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Run and show in the SQL Table panel

sqlReportsEditor.label: Color White
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Everything white + the returned rows their colors

sqlReportsEditor.label: Color Hidden
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Isolate the result: hits keep their colors, everything else fades to opacity 0

sqlReportsEditor.label: Color Transparent
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Like Color White, but the base coat is white at 10% opacity — the rest of the model stays faintly visible

sqlReportsEditor.label: Color Set
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Run your current Set Color rules + the result appended as one extra Multi rule (Set Color panel untouched)

sqlReportsEditor.label: Color Selection
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Select the result in the viewer: every returned fullname becomes the selection (colors untouched)

sqlReportsEditor.label: As Detail
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Bind this draft to the SQL Detail panel (follows viewport clicks). ALT+click prints the bound SQL.

sqlReportsEditor.label: Expand all
sqlReportsEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-chevrons-down "><path d="M7 7l5 5l5 -5"></path><path d="M7 13l5 5l5 -5"></path></svg>

sqlReportsEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-trash "><path d="M4 7l16 0"></path><path d="M10 11l0 6"></path><path d="M14 11l0 6"></path><path d="M5 7l1 12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h8a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2l1 -12"></path><path d="M9 7v-3a1 1 0 0 1 1 -1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v3"></path></svg>

sqlReportsEditor.label: Single select
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Let the report's user pick ONE option instead of several (the picks still reach the SQL as FILTER_ARGS rows — at most one)

sqlReportsEditor.label: Test/selected
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip:
Also the predefined selection: what you pick here is saved
with the report and pre-selected when the report is used.

sqlReportsEditor.label: Save
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Save this report to the store's SQL_Reports.json

sqlReportsEditor.label: Cancel
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Discard changes

sqlReportsEditor.label: Set editor
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Put this report's definition (unsaved edits included) into the SQL Editor, replacing what is there — asks first

sqlReportsEditor.label: Delete
sqlReportsEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-trash "><path d="M4 7l16 0"></path><path d="M10 11l0 6"></path><path d="M14 11l0 6"></path><path d="M5 7l1 12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h8a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2l1 -12"></path><path d="M9 7v-3a1 1 0 0 1 1 -1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v3"></path></svg>
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Delete this report

sqlReportsEditor.label: Input / Dropdown
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: A text box, or a list filled by the dropdown SQL

sqlReportsEditor.label: key / Label
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: The name the SQL reads (FILTER_ARGS.k) and the text shown beside the input

sqlReportsEditor.label: Default value / search default
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: Input: the value filled in at the start. Dropdown: the search used while the box is empty (usually %)

sqlReportsEditor.label: Dropdown SQL
sqlReportsEditor.tooltip: The query that fills the list: an id column and a label column; ? is the search text

sqlEditor.label: Name / Description
sqlEditor.tooltip: The name and text a report saved from here gets

sqlEditor.label: Clear
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-trash "><path d="M4 7l16 0"></path><path d="M10 11l0 6"></path><path d="M14 11l0 6"></path><path d="M5 7l1 12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h8a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2l1 -12"></path><path d="M9 7v-3a1 1 0 0 1 1 -1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v3"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Empty the editor — name, description, SQL, filters and types (asks first). The Main db pick stays

sqlEditor.label: Save Local
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-device-floppy "><path d="M6 4h10l4 4v10a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-12a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2v-12a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2"></path><path d="M10 14a2 2 0 1 0 4 0a2 2 0 1 0 -4 0"></path><path d="M14 4l0 4l-6 0l0 -4"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Add the current draft to SQL Reports as a new report, saved in the Main db's store — pick a Main db first

sqlEditor.label: Main db
sqlEditor.tooltip: The database opened directly. Pick None to run purely off ATTACH'd files (an in-memory scratch db is used).

sqlEditor.label: Assets
sqlEditor.tooltip: Open the SQL Assets panel to import or delete databases

sqlEditor.label: Types: COLORING / TABLE / DETAIL
sqlEditor.tooltip: Enable the COLORING output

sqlEditor.label: Info (i)
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-info-circle "><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 18 0a9 9 0 0 0 -18 0"></path><path d="M12 9h.01"></path><path d="M11 12h1v4h1"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: How report SQL runs

sqlEditor.label: Run
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-player-play "><path d="M7 4v16l13 -8l-13 -8"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Run the script (Ctrl+Enter in the editor) — results go to the Console panel. FILTER_ARGS is seeded from the filters below

sqlEditor.label: Shared
sqlEditor.tooltip: Exclusive = writes allowed, one tab at a time. Shared = read-only, several readers at once.

sqlEditor.label: Kill
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-player-stop "><path d="M5 7a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v10a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-10a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2l0 -10"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Terminate the SQLite worker — cancels the running query and releases its file locks

sqlEditor.label: Color White
sqlEditor.tooltip: Everything white + the result colored (needs a fullname column; fullname_color optional, defaults yellow)

sqlEditor.label: Color Transparent
sqlEditor.tooltip: Like Color White, but the base coat is white at 10% opacity — the rest of the model stays faintly visible behind the colored result

sqlEditor.label: Color Hidden
sqlEditor.tooltip: Isolate the result: the returned rows colored (fullname_color, defaults yellow), everything else faded to opacity 0 (Reset model in Set Color recovers)

sqlEditor.label: Color Set
sqlEditor.tooltip: Run your current Set Color rules + the result appended as one extra Multi rule (fullname_color optional, defaults yellow). Nothing is saved to the Set Color panel.

sqlEditor.label: Color Selection
sqlEditor.tooltip: Select the result in the viewer: every returned fullname becomes the selection (replaces the current one; colors untouched, fullname_color ignored)

sqlEditor.label: As Table
sqlEditor.tooltip: Run and show the result in the SQL Table panel. TREE_VIEW_ARGS is seeded from the last selection — tree click, viewport pick or U / P (like Run and the color buttons), so a detail-style query can be checked here with the values it will really see

sqlEditor.label: As Detail
sqlEditor.tooltip: Bind this SQL to the SQL Detail panel — clicks run it against the clicked hierarchy. SQL that reads TREE_VIEW_ARGS is bound as written; otherwise it is wrapped as select * from (…) where fullname in (select fullname from TREE_VIEW_ARGS) limit 1, so it needs a fullname column. ALT+click logs the SQL actually bound to the Console.

sqlEditor.label: Expand all
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-chevrons-down "><path d="M7 7l5 5l5 -5"></path><path d="M7 13l5 5l5 -5"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Expand all filters

sqlEditor.label: Collapse all
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-chevrons-up "><path d="M7 11l5 -5l5 5"></path><path d="M7 17l5 -5l5 5"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Collapse all filters

sqlEditor.label: Add filter
sqlEditor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-plus "><path d="M12 5l0 14"></path><path d="M5 12l14 0"></path></svg>
sqlEditor.tooltip: Add a filter input

sqlEditor.label: SQL box
sqlEditor.tooltip: The SQL. Ctrl+Enter runs; Tab / Shift+Tab indent. Highlight part of it to run only that part.

sqlTable.label: Load all
sqlTable.tooltip: Re-run this report without the 50-row cap (max 250,000)

sqlTable.label: Clear on close
sqlTable.tooltip: Clear on close is ON: closing this panel throws the result away and frees its rows. Click to KEEP it instead — reopening the panel then shows the same rows without re-running the report.

sqlTable.label: Select all (corner box)
sqlTable.tooltip: Select every row shown — click again to deselect all

sqlTable.label: Column title
sqlTable.tooltip: Click to sort A→Z, again Z→A, a third time unsorted. Drag the edge to resize.

sqlTable.label: filter…
sqlTable.tooltip: Show only rows whose value in this column contains the text (all filled columns must match)

sqlTable.label: Row number
sqlTable.tooltip: Click to select a row — Ctrl adds or removes one, Shift selects a range

sqlTable.label: Export to Excel (all)
sqlTable.tooltip: Right-click menu: every row as shown to an .xlsx file

sqlTable.label: Export to Excel (selected rows)
sqlTable.tooltip: Right-click menu: only the selected rows

sqlTable.label: Copy to clipboard (all)
sqlTable.tooltip: Right-click menu: every row as shown, tab-separated

sqlTable.label: Copy to clipboard (selected rows)
sqlTable.tooltip: Right-click menu: only the selected rows

sqlDetail.label: Listening
sqlDetail.tooltip: Follow the selection — every tree click, viewport pick, U / P or API selection fills this form from that node

sqlDetail.label: Hide empty
sqlDetail.tooltip: Hide fields whose value is null or empty

sqlDetail.label: Filter fields…
sqlDetail.tooltip: Show only the fields whose name or value contains the text
